description: Welcome to Suite Scandicci, an exceptional 90 m² apartment located on the 3rd floor with a lift. Its authentic American design elegantly blends contemporary lines with classic touches. It offers 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, 2 toilets, a large bright living room, a fully equipped kitchen and high-end materials. The master suite is a true oasis of comfort. Private terrace with a view.The spaceThe Scandicci Suite is an elegant 90 m² apartment, located on the 3rd floor of a building with a lift. Perfectly designed to accommodate up to 7 people, it offers a comfortable and refined living environment for an unforgettable stay in Paris.Here is the layout of this harmonious space:Bright living room with cozy sofa bed, and an ideal dining area for your convivial moments.Fully equipped open kitchen, where you can prepare your meals with high-end equipment: hotplates, microwave, kettle, coffee on site, oven, and a coffee machine.Welcoming master bedroom with a Queen size bed, perfect for a well-deserved night's rest, opening onto a majestic balcony. Secondary bedroom with a double bed.Tertiary room with 2 single beds.Modern and luxurious bathroom with bathtub, shower gel, shampoo, hairdryer and toilet for added convenience.Second bathroom with a shower. 1 other separate toilet. In total 2 toilets in the accommodation. A large bright balcony.The apartment has many amenities for your comfort: free wifi, sheets, blankets and a set of towels per person. Here you will find everything you need for a pleasant and practical stay.Guest accessFeel at home here! The accommodation is entirely yours for the duration of your stay, and all the equipment is at your disposal so that you don't miss anything.Other things to noteStaying at 34 rue Scandicci means settling in the epicentre of the cultural
